description.value: Prince Rupert Visitor Information Centre is the official tourism information hub for Prince Rupert, BC — a coastal city on British Columbia's wild North Coast that serves as a gateway to the Great Bear Rainforest, world-class fishing, and rich Ts'msyen cultural heritage. The centre provides maps, brochures, and downloadable guides covering hiking trails, wildlife viewing, outdoor adventure, and local dining, and also offers phone and email visitor services. For a touring cyclist arriving by BC Ferries or venturing through this remote northern destination, it is a practical first stop for trip planning and local orientation.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 32m; rack at 95m.

The phone number 250-624-5637 appears consistently across multiple pages but is absent from OSM. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so all amenity fields are null.
